_orchestratorNote: CPR8/R7 PIN, added when numHarts=5 + orchestrator=true became the SHIPPED DEFAULT. Argus is the frozen 18-hart teaching chip and has NO orchestrator: hart 0 is a plain hart_tile like the other seventeen, SH_AW is 16 for its 128 KiB shared RAM (not for TCM apertures), and extended flash stays where the Argus map puts it. Without this explicit false the row would INHERIT the new default (the R-DK3 inheritance trap: only the penta/castalia4 configs name this knob), silently turning the teaching chip into an 18-hart orchestrator. Pinned, not changed -- this is the shape argus.json already resolved to before the promotion.
